results.title: Midterms
results.plot: During midterms, Selina tries to secure a more powerful role, while the arrival of Kent Davison shakes up the entire staff.

results.title: Signals
results.plot: Selina attends a pig roast in North Carolina as part of the president's 'Listen to Rural America' initiative. Dan takes up Pilates to get face time.

results.title: Hostages
results.plot: Selina and Secretary of Defense Maddox clash over the hostage crisis, while Sue testifies to congress.

results.title: The Vic Allen Dinner
results.plot: Selina and the team prepare for the annual Vic Allen Dinner, as the news takes on the hostage story.

results.title: Helsinki
results.plot: As the song makes Selina's trip to Helsinki more difficult than expected, the White House erupts over a rumor.

results.title: Andrew
results.plot: Selina attempts to finalize a budget deal while simultaneously dealing with rumors about her family image.

results.title: Shutdown
results.plot: With D.C. in the midst of a government shutdown, Selina is forced to furlough some of her staff. A damaging story leaks about Selina's ex-husband Andrew; Danny Chung takes advantage of the shutdown; Gary and Jonah go on a run to retrieve Selina's trash.

results.title: First Response
results.plot: After being prepped for a 'puff piece' interview at the VP residence, Selina is thrown by Janet Ryland's 'gotcha' questions.

results.title: Running
results.plot: Undeterred by a message that POTUS wants Selina to limit her public appearances, the Veep continues her plans. Dan attempts to play both sides of the Selina/Danny Chung rivalry.

results.title: D.C.
results.plot: (Season Two Finale) With the administration in full crisis mode and Selina's future in doubt, the entire staff goes on frenzied job hunt.
